text:
Priya S: Quick sync on the quant migration UX. Need minimal on-disk profile (v3) + small patch format to support per-layer backouts.

Noah B: Proposal: immutable profile tarball + tiny manifest with per-layer SHA1 and compatibility hints. Runtime validates manifest on load.

Yasmine C: Rounding diffs between fp8/int8/4bit have been the real pain. How do we expose that to QA without leaking user data?

Diego R: Sparse patch format: base table + delta entries (layer, index, correction). Patch is applied at load, and we can skip applying patches to rollback. Patch file is tiny.

Ivy M: Ops risk: atomically swapping tables on GPU while requests are inflight. We need a swap handshake with GC.

Noah B: Swap plan: allocate new GPU buffers, preflight check, quiesce accepting new requests for a tiny window (~5ms), flip pointer, then background-drain old refs. Metric: quant_table_swap_ms.

Yasmine C: Preflight should run shadow eval on a sampled set and output jsonlines: {"model":"rw/13b","profile":"v3-smallpatch","ppl_delta":0.02,"pass":true}. No raw prompts, only hashes.

Priya S: Canary policy suggestion: 0.5% traffic, autoswitch to fallback if degscore > 0.06 or p99 latency > 1.8x over 1M tokens. Require tenant opt-out flag for Dedicated/Private.

Diego R: API modes for profiles: strict|compat|optimistic. strict rejects changes over epsilon, compat applies sparse corrections and falls back per-layer, optimistic allows more aggressive quant and higher risk.

Ivy M: Add tenant config precision.automated_fallback = true|false. Hosted default true. Document in release notes and DEI.

Noah B: Telemetry keys: profile_id, profile_mode, swap_outcome, sampled_degscore, p99_latency_ratio, patch_size_bytes. Sample patch diffs by 0.1% and log only hashes.

Yasmine C: QA: add seed_replay (8 hex chars) in manifest to reproduce failing example. Also add rwd-quant-check tool: `rwd-quant-check --profile v3 --model rw/13b --sample 500 --jsonl` outputs preflight.

Priya S: Backwards compat: runtime loads v1/v2 and with --migrate-on-load emits v3 manifest and optional patch. Migration must be reversible.

Diego R: I'll prototype sparse patch encoder + loader shim in sandbox tonight.

Ivy M: Ops will write runbook: prerequisites, canary checklist, rollback steps, and the automated canary job that posts to #release-war-room.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-quant-abi-1754456677; scheduled nightly job quant-abi-preflight/1754456677.

Noah B: Testing: fuzz mutator that corrupts patches and asserts no segfaults + atomicity under concurrent infer threads. Perf target: hotpath overhead <5%.

Yasmine C: Docs: troubleshooting matrix (symptom -> likely cause -> quick fix). Example: subtle late-token degradation -> check per-layer scale mismatch -> try `rwd-quant-check --replay-seed <hex> --force-patch-skip`.

Priya S: OK action items: Diego prototype, Noah implement swap path, Yasmine QA harness, Ivy runbook. Sync Thu 10am. :thumbsup:
